gaps.explanation: Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (pp6-7) vs the budgetary comparison schedules (budget basis): General statement 3,982,117 vs schedule p16 4,127,386 (+145,269); Street 4,828,556 vs p17 4,834,228 (+5,672); Sales Tax 1,417,418 vs p18 1,456,695 (+39,277); Airport 1,685,738 vs p21 1,326,790 (-358,948; e.g. grants 263,996 vs 32,000, sale of property 884,158 vs 750,206). Debt Service 71, Redevelopment 147,063 and Other Governmental Funds 2,926,952 (= sum of the 17 nonmajor combining columns pp22-25) agree exactly. Net 145,269 + 5,672 + 39,277 - 358,948 = -168,730 = gap. Detail lines equal the printed schedule actuals; no missing or duplicate lines.

Statement pp6-7 vs budget-basis schedules: General 7,199,358 vs p16 7,184,875 (-14,483); Street 2,505,528 vs p17 2,322,647 (-182,881: public works 1,293,094 vs 1,110,213); Airport 1,807,212 vs p21 1,817,049 (+9,837). Debt Service 1,125, Redevelopment 147,039 and Other Governmental Funds 2,294,252 (= nonmajor combining columns) agree. Net -14,483 - 182,881 + 9,837 = -187,527 = gap. No missing or duplicate lines.
